summary.text: Karen Lupton is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 83 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: She succeeded Becky Evans in District 83, assuming office on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Education Committee, the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee and the Human Relations and Aging Committee.
